subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: For no-reply tool-error turns, should OpenClaw surface a compact exec-like warning and incomplete-turn fallback when payloadCount is zero, or should lastToolError continue to suppress those paths unless the tool is mutating or verbose details are enabled?
rationale: The remaining code change is not just mechanical: it changes user-visible failure policy and must balance message loss against noisy warnings and duplicate side-effect risk.

options.title: Surface only when no reply exists
options.body: Show compact exec-like warnings and allow incomplete-turn fallback for payloadCount=0 only when no user-facing reply or committed delivery exists, with focused tests for read-only and side-effecting tools.

options.title: Keep fail-closed suppression
options.body: Leave the current suppression behavior in place and route affected users to the broader placeholder and replay-unsafe canonical issues until a larger terminal-state policy is designed.

options.title: Split into canonical issues
options.body: Close only the fixed placeholder half against the canonical placeholder thread and move the fallback half under the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn policy issue.

recommendation.title: Surface only when no reply exists
recommendation.body: Show compact exec-like warnings and allow incomplete-turn fallback for payloadCount=0 only when no user-facing reply or committed delivery exists, with focused tests for read-only and side-effecting tools.
